description: Approaches that did not work, with the reason. Sources: internal write-ups of 2026-10-29 and the files in this folder.

items.what: Hardware decode (NVDEC through VA-API) inside headless Chrome
items.result: GPU process crashes when the decoded frame is handed to compositing; nvidia-smi dec stays at 0%.
items.why: chrome-headless-shell is built without VA-API. Chrome for Testing with nvidia-vaapi-driver 0.0.18 opens the decoder (VideoDecoder.isConfigSupported true only with --gl=angle-egl), but the GPU process exits when the decoded frame goes to compositing ("GPU process exited unexpectedly"). Chrome for Testing also lacks the shared-memory capture of Remotion's build.

items.what: Capture only the area that changed
items.why: Capture -19 s CPU, but recomposition in Node +32.4 s (vs 8.1 s for ffmpeg decoding full PNGs); Chrome rasterizes differently with a clip (816 of 2241 frames differ inside the clip).

items.result: "did not actually make the render faster, rather slower" (Remotion issue #4468).
items.why: Same outcome as our dirty-rect prototype.

items.what: Graphics layer through renderMedia with shared memory + NVENC
items.result: More CPU than a PNG sequence.
items.why: Encoding inside the render pipeline added CPU instead of removing it.

items.what: ProRes 4444 or VP9-alpha for the graphics layer
items.result: More CPU to encode than it saves to decode.
items.why: ProRes +86.8 s and VP9 +20.0 s of encode to save at most 2.4 s of PNG decode.
2 jobs: wall -28%, CPU +20%. Off by default.

items.what: Remotion WAV render for the audio mix
items.why: 617.7 s CPU and 15 GB for 74.7 s of audio; replaced by an ffmpeg mix.
SSIM 0.974 to 0.949 against Chrome; spline36 kept.

items.what: h264_vulkan encode, Vulkan-to-CUDA hwmap, one concat across decoders
items.why: h264_vulkan failed to encode; hwmap Vulkan to CUDA is not implemented (hwupload=derive_device=cuda works); concat rejects Vulkan frames from different decoders, so one ffmpeg per segment.
